source_license_scope: publisher metadata declares CC BY 4.0 for retained sources. This filter removes direct known NC/unclear inputs; upstream/third-party rights and attribution still require review, notably PWD2021/Ebbu and PhishBD/ISCX. No commercial clearance or production readiness is established
baseline: clone original v6 constructor parameters and fit vocabulary/IDF/scaler/classifier/calibrator from scratch on filtered partitions only; original C2, 100k char/20k word, source_sqrt, row sigmoid
expert_fit: Logistic Regression on private-host fitting rows only, using the baseline fit-only encoder; source_sqrt/domain_sqrt/soft-source-class weights clipped to [0.2,5] then mean-normalized; retain publisher labels
expert_calibration: independent row sigmoid C1000 on private-host calibration only, positive slope, >=100 benign and >=100 phishing required
baseline_thresholds: original v6 per-source rule on filtered threshold partition
private_thresholds: pooled private-host benign FPR budgets on separate filtered threshold partition; >=100 benign required, conservative tie handling; identical constraint applied to private-matched baseline and experts
routed_scores: retain calibrated probabilities without logit/score remapping; classify using per-row general/private thresholds. Compute Brier/logloss/ECE on actual probabilities, confusion and domain-bootstrap on actual decisions
selection: tune only. Private recall gain>=0.02 vs private-matched baseline; no private recall loss>0.005 vs native baseline; private FPR increase<=0.0025 vs both references; macro source recall loss<=0.005, no source recall loss>0.03, macro Brier increase<=0.001 and max source FPR increase<=0.0025 vs native baseline. Rank eligible by private recall then lower macro Brier; otherwise retain baseline and freeze best failed-gate expert for diagnostics
evaluation: replay all 11 previously observed cohorts from the current-retrain experiment after artifact/threshold/selection freeze. Cached historical reference scores must be hash-bound to ordered cohorts and models; replay probes verify alignment. Historical NC data may be used for research diagnostics only, not training/calibration/threshold/tune
exposure: preserve all registries, all eight sidecars, every holdout and ALL169393 Mendeley reserved; no new intake or synthetic labels
operational_work: separate authenticated shadow gateway with its own source manifest and parent-runtime binding, global quota, bounded body/response, bounded inflight predictions, deadlines retaining slots until real computation completes, aggregate-only telemetry; real-artifact parity and synthetic in-process load tests
human_evidence: audit real review inputs without fabricating reviewers/labels; unavailable evidence remains a release blocker
